author: Josette Riley
text: Just got mine 2 weeks ago. I love it so far . My problem is low reading mostly during the night. The alarm scares the heck out of me but I’m not waking up during the night worrying about where my numbers are.

author: Susan Jenkins
text: You can use a finger stick to check highs and lows just like the little note that pops up says. You can’t use a scanner and your phone to read the sensor. I have an I Phone 12 pro and both my phone and Apple Watch have the latest IOS 25 something. My watch is set up to mirror my phone so I have the libre app on my watch. Guess what? The phone app pushers the scans to my watch just like alarms!! I have to open the app to read the scan but I no longer have to have phone pockets in the house.
